name: NGC 4073 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 4073, the central elliptical galaxy of the galaxy group MKW 4, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc4073-hubble
story: NGC 4073 sits at the center of MKW 4, a group of galaxies bathed in hot gas that shines in X-rays. Hubble surveyed the globular clusters around it to learn how one of the most massive galaxies of today's universe was assembled.

claims.text: NGC 4073 is the central dominant galaxy of the galaxy group MKW 4
MKW 4 has a hot X-ray-emitting halo (studied by XMM-Newton)
NGC 4073 is an elliptical galaxy targeted by Hubble program 15265
Hubble program 15265 studies the globular cluster systems of the most massive MASSIVE Survey galaxies to trace their growth histories
